segments.text: Mama, where do we go when we die?
Somewhere gentle, my love. Our body rests, and the part of us that loves and feels goes back to Allah.
Yes. We came from Him, and one day we return to Him. It is not the end. It is like finally going home.
Not for a heart that loved Allah. A peaceful soul rests softly, waiting for a beautiful morning.
And when that morning comes, Allah welcomes the ones who loved Him into a garden that never ends.
O peaceful soul, return to your Lord, well pleased and pleasing to Him. Enter among My servants, and enter My Paradise.
